sideA.text: This is our month. Every November, Utopia releases new Hollow Men into the world. For two days, they are distracted. Our recon into the city needs to happen this month or we’ll miss our opportunity. We don’t know what we’ll find in there or what we’ll find at PEARL. We need to be prepared for anything.

sideB.text:
JUNE 18, YEAR 10

10 years upon the seas. 5 years toward a cure. Some on the havens still don’t want to help the world, after they had quarantined us here. I understand though. No one knew the long-term effects of COdA. Our minds are ours again, but our skin is forever faded. Even our children are born faded. These havens proved to be a godsend as we were isolated when the plague struck. Our prison became humanity’s last hope.
sideB.footer: Keep papers like this in the reserve.
